title: ERC-8004 revoking feedback and appending responses
summary: A client leaves low feedback, the agent appends a response pointing to a refund, an aggregator appends a spam tag, and the client finally revokes. Responses never change the value; revocation removes it from summaries.

steps.label: giveFeedback(4242, 20, 0, "successRate", ...)
steps.detail: Stored as feedbackIndex 1 for this client.

steps.label: appendResponse(4242, client, 1, responseURI, responseHash)
steps.detail: Anyone may respond; here the agent links a file that shows a refund. The reference code requires a non-empty responseURI and emits ResponseAppended.

payload.content:
// Illustrative example, spec version Draft 2026-01-25.
ReputationRegistry(0x8004BAa17C55a88189AE136b182e5fdA19dE9b63).appendResponse(4242, 0xA11C...A11C, 1, "ipfs://bafy...refund", bytes32(0))

failures.condition: feedbackIndex is 0 or past the last index
failures.outcome: Reverts with "index must be > 0" or "index out of bounds".

steps.label: appendResponse(..., spam tag)
steps.detail: An aggregator can append its own judgment, for example a spam label. getResponseCount can filter by responder.

steps.label: revokeFeedback(4242, 1)
steps.detail: Only the original client can revoke. isRevoked becomes true and FeedbackRevoked is emitted. There is no un-revoke.

steps.label: Return FeedbackRevoked
steps.detail: getSummary now skips the entry, and readAllFeedback omits it unless includeRevoked is true. The responses stay on record.
